title: P.T (Playable Teaser)
bullets: UI: No reticle; no main menu.

Mechanics: Hallway loops with environmental changes between passes; exit door opens after the loop-specific progression trigger is satisfied, often with an audio cue; no sprint; controller vibration during door collisions and Lisa-related sequences; flashlight beam follows camera movement; flashlight is acquired later rather than provided at the start.

Loop Behaviour: Progress depends on loop-specific triggers; a closed exit door can indicate an incomplete action; some triggers require looking at an object or pressing X; Lisa's haunting can interrupt progression or lead to another loop.

Objective Management: Explore the hallway and inspect environmental changes; infer required actions from visual and audio cues; objectives are rarely explained explicitly; some sequences involve focusing on objects or using the microphone.

Controls: R3 — zoom; left thumbstick — forward movement is faster than backward movement; fixed camera sensitivity; when moving, the player camera utilizes first-person head bob and lateral camera sway to simulate realistic human gait dynamics.

Audio: No continuous background music; ambient sounds carry most of the atmosphere such as rain, footsteps, swinging chandelier, banging door, crying baby, Lisa sobbing or groaning; ominous music during selected sequences; there is a specific beat when Lisa starts to groan or appear; utilizes a blend of 3D spatial audio and 2D stereo sound design.

Encounters: Lisa closes the bathroom door; Lisa appears standing in the hallway then disappears, the lights switch off and back on with cockroaches visible on the walls; After the window falls, Lisa appears on the upper floor staring at the player before retreating out of sight.
Misc: No visible player body when looking down; bathroom door opens, cockroaches emerge from the bathroom.
Pain Point: R2 would be a more practical zoom input than R3 to avoid clicking the right thumbstick.

title: Evil Inside
bullets: UI: Dynamic main menu.
Mechanics: Flashlight features an inner and outer cone, and cannot be turned off; heavily inspired by P.T. featuring a ghost girl, hallway layout, banging doors, a giant eye, and loops.
Objective Management: Interactable objects are highlighted to guide the player and progress the game.
Pain Point: Camera sensitivity is too high and cannot be adjusted.

title: BrokenLore: Don't Watch
bullets: UI: Dynamic main menu; fades out from the main menu to the first level; reticle only appears when an object is interactable.
Mechanics: Phone functions as a flashlight; switches to 8-bit graphics halfway through the game; story features a loop where the player returns to the same location.
Misc: Small flat; usage of post-processing effects.
Objective Management: Displays objectives in the bottom-left corner of the screen, which then fade out.
Pain Point: Subtitles could be larger, as the spoken audio is in a foreign language.

title: Greyhill Incident
bullets: UI: Dynamic main menu with a side bar layout.
Mechanics: Stamina meter limits sprint duration; voice-line cues trigger when walking off-path (e.g., "I shouldn't be going this way") to soft-gate boundaries.
Misc: Intro cutscenes blend environmental establishing shots of the location with background NPC dialogue.
Objective Management: Objectives can be viewed in the pause menu.
Pain Point: Lack of in-game waypoints; restrictive stamina system; button prompts are too small to read easily.

title: Home Sweet Home
bullets: Controls: Square (flashlight), Triangle (notebook), Circle (crouch), L2 hold (run).
UI: Interactable objects are highlighted visually; dynamic main menu features sound effects when selecting options.
Mechanics: Main ghost uses waypoint pathfinding; enemy detection relies on a cone-shaped vision field (raycasting); distinct audio cue plays when detected by the ghost.
Misc: First-person model shows no body—just the left hand holding a flashlight; Small map design that prevents getting lost.
Objective Management: Briefly displays the current goal at the top-center of the screen before fading out; Pressing Triangle opens a notebook.
Pain Point: Repetitive loop (stealth, obtain item); lack of a reticle;

title: Infliction Extended Cut
bullets: UI: Dynamic main menu rendered in real-time; includes a 'read to plain text' feature for readable notes (needs more polish).
Mechanics: Controller vibration becomes erratic as the ghost gets closer.
Misc: Unsettling ghost animations (running, crawling, twitching blend).
Pain Point: No sprint mechanic; overreliance on jumpscares; reticle doesn't indicate which objects are important since all items are interactable.
